column3: The BSB places “unceasingly” at the start of verse 3.
The opening “continually” is in verse 2 in the Greek; endurance of hope is rendered as “enduring hope.”
Your election is recast as God having chosen you.
“In spite of” makes the relation to suffering concessive.
Our entrance is rendered as “welcome you gave us.”
The participle delivering is rendered as the noun “deliverer.”
